svg.aria-label: Bode plot of 10 over s(1 + 0.4s)(1 + 0.1s): the magnitude falls at minus 20 dB per decade, then minus 40 after 2.5 rad/s and minus 60 after 10 rad/s; gain crossover is at 4.46 rad/s and phase crossover at 5 rad/s, giving a phase margin of 5.2 degrees and a gain margin of 1.94 dB

g.text: dashed grey: asymptotes · ωgc = 4.46 rad/s · ωpc = 5 rad/s · stable, but only just
